jokes: What do snowmen eat for breakfast? Frosted flakes!
What do elves learn at school? The elf-abet!
What do reindeer say before a joke? This will sleigh you!
What do snowmen wear on their heads? Ice caps!
Why was the snowman looking at carrots? He was picking his nose!
What do you call a singing elf? A wrapper!
What falls but never gets hurt? Snow!
Why did Santa visit the garden? To hoe, hoe, hoe!
What is Santa’s favourite type of music? Wrap!
What do you call a cold dog? A chilli dog!
How do snowmen travel? By icicle!
What do you get when you cross a bell and a skunk? Jingle smells!
What did one snowflake say to another? You’re one of a kind!
Why was the Christmas tree bad at sewing? It kept dropping its needles!
What do gingerbread people use for beds? Cookie sheets!
Why did the ornament go to school? To get a little brighter!
What is a snowman’s favourite drink? Ice tea!
What do you call Santa on a beach? Sandy Claus!
How does a sheep say Merry Christmas? Fleece Navidad!
Why did the present blush? It was all wrapped up!
